Class ElementColors

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.ElementColors
public final class ElementColors extends Object
Reloadable, owner-scoped element colors, independent of molecular chemistry and graphics classes.

All mutations validate and publish one immutable snapshot atomically. They are safe from any thread; renderers pick up the latest snapshot on their next draw. No graphics resources are touched here. Higher priorities win, followed by lexicographically later owner IDs for ties. Client resource packs supply the base; these layers override packs; the user's local palette overrides these layers.

Registrations are process-local, are not synchronized from a server, survive world disconnect, and must be registered again after restarting. Dedicated-server calls are harmless but have no visual effect on clients. Keep common registration here and client resource reloading in AvogadroClientApi.reloadElementColors(). At most 64 owners and 512 colors per owner are retained. See the element-color guide for Java, Groovy and JSON examples.

    • snapshot

      public static ElementColors.Snapshot snapshot()
      Reads the currently published overrides without locking or allocating.
      Returns:
      immutable snapshot; retain it if a multi-step operation needs consistent colors

    • replace

      public static ElementColors.Snapshot replace(String owner, int priority, Map<String,Integer> colors)
      Atomically replaces all colors for one owner. An empty map removes that contribution. No file, resource pack, other owner, or existing export snapshot is changed. Unknown but syntactically valid symbols may be registered before a custom element exists; a color entry does not itself register a chemical element.
      Parameters:
      owner - namespaced identifier, for example mymod:atom_colors, at most 128 characters
      priority - higher numbers override lower numbers; ties sort by owner ID
      colors - at most 512 symbol-to-RGB entries, each value in 0x000000..0xFFFFFF
      Returns:
      the resulting effective programmatic snapshot
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid IDs, symbols, alpha values, or capacity overflow

    • patch

      public static ElementColors.Snapshot patch(String owner, Map<String,Integer> colors)
      Merges entries into an existing owner while retaining its priority. New owners start at priority zero. Use replace(String, int, Map) to remove omitted entries or change priority. Invalid patches retain all old values.
      Parameters:
      owner - contribution identifier
      colors - replacement values for selected symbols
      Returns:
      resulting effective snapshot

    • remove

      public static ElementColors.Snapshot remove(String owner)
      Removes only this owner's override, revealing lower-priority contributions or resource-pack colors.
      Parameters:
      owner - contribution identifier
      Returns:
      resulting effective snapshot; unchanged when the owner was absent

    • replaceJson

      public static ElementColors.Snapshot replaceJson(String owner, int priority, String json) throws IOException
      Reloads an owner's complete palette from strict JSON, such as {"C":"#405060"}. Read an application-owned file before calling; this method performs no filesystem access. Duplicate keys, malformed colors, trailing data, and input larger than 32 KiB are rejected before publication. Failure leaves the previous owner's contribution untouched.
      Parameters:
      owner - contribution identifier
      priority - contribution precedence
      json - partial element-color JSON object, using six-digit hex strings
      Returns:
      resulting effective snapshot
      Throws:
      IOException - if JSON or a color value is invalid
